style: Read this like an energetic, witty Indian stand-up comic doing a fake luxury real-estate ad. Clear Indian English accent, fast and punchy, playful sarcasm, big smile in the voice, mid-to-high pitch, never deep or slow:

lines.text: Can't afford a house in Bengaluru?
Introducing... land. In Bengaluru. For just ten rupees!
No landlord asking, veg or non-veg?
Two hundred and forty-three real BBMP wards.
Pick a cell. Boom. It's yours.
Then write your frustration on it...
for the whole city to read.
Landlords, brokers, water tankers. Everybody gets roasted.
And the most luxurious feature of all...
Hurry. Prices go up after Navratri.
